notes.title: v1.6.0 The Final Update
notes.content:
We regret to inform you that, due to various reasons, we will be ceasing updates for the game "Survivor's Fantasia" effective immediately. Unless there are critical bugs that significantly impact gameplay, no substantial updates will be released. The details of the update are as follows:

    1.Weapon Enhancement Overhaul
        There are now a total of 57 different weapon enhancements available. Each weapon can have one or multiple corresponding enhancements.

    2.New Weapon: Enhancement Books
        Introducing Flame, Thunder, Freeze, Illusion, Bloodsucking, and Barrage Books. These books can be used to enhance weapons.
        The game now offers a grand total of almost 100 items, including 67 weapons and 30 attribute items.

    3.Reworked Damage Logic
        Weapon damage is now determined by the base damage of the weapon.

    4.Strengthened and Modified Certain Items
        Enhancements for melee, elemental, and summoning-related items have been modified.

    5.Bug Fix: Reimu's Skill
        Fixed a bug related to the skill of the character Reimu.

    6.Bug Fix: First Map Obstacle Activation
        Fixed a bug where the obstacles in the first map were not activating.

    Other Bug Fixes

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused. Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: 1.3.0 Update
notes.content:
New:
1: Added a sprint mechanism. Now pressing the space can consume 3.3% of your health for sprinting.
The sprint process is brief and invincible, and can overcome obstacles.
2: New prop: Ghost shoes. When the conditions are met, immune to damage and automatically sprint before taking damage.
3: New item: Star necklace, increases player attributes as health percentage decreases.
4: New item: Impact shield, deals damage to enemies when sprinting.
Modification:
Added the option to maintain random seeds within the local area
Adjusted and optimized the UI of the store
Store changed to automatically open every minute instead of manually
Fixed some bugs
Fixed the issue of some prop images flickering
Fixed errors in some prop sound effects
Modified the calculation formula for damage
Modified the calculation method of grid blocks
A certain map of the dungeon is now symmetrical
Adjusted some props
Trap Spring Fist will knock enemies with health below 50% away (flash kill)
When in an invincible state now, the character's avatar will have an icon display

notes.title: v1.0.8 update
notes.content:
Optimization of Shop's Item Refresh Mechanism
Now, the more you purchase items of the same category, the easier it is to refresh items of that category.
Professions have a higher chance of refreshing items corresponding to their type.
Newly added items will enhance the player's attributes based on their type.
Fixed a bug where certain items would still update while in pause mode.
Fixed a bug where defense towers would flash and shrink when stacked.
Changed the temporary attribute-enhancing potions from active items to passive items that enhance attributes.
Balanced some items.
Increased the range of the Forest Map's idol and now the idol can push back enemies.
Increased the initial monster spawn speed by 20%.

notes.title: v1.0.7 Update
notes.content:
Damage Calculation and Card Type Rework
Damage types have been redefined as melee, ranged, elemental, summoning, explosive, and special.
Special damage ignores monster damage reduction.
Monsters no longer have armor and are instead subjected to percentage-based damage reduction.
The piercing attribute has been changed to a reduction in percentage-based damage reduction for monsters.
Melee damage is reduced by 10%, piercing damage by 5%, and other types by 5%.
Alice and Ling'er's skills have been greatly enhanced.
New damage cards have been introduced: Thorn Armor and Christmas Tree Spear.
New attribute-boosting cards have been added.
The UI layout has been slightly adjusted.
Fixed a bug where the "vampirism" attribute was ineffective.
Fixed a bug where the "damage reduction" attribute was ineffective.
Fixed a bug where damage reduction could be lowered to -100% in certain cases.
Various other bugs have been fixed.
Game prices are about to be increased.

•Monsters now have increased knockback resistance as their level increases.
•The game will be priced at 1.69 dollars after the official release on next Monday.

notes.title: v1.041 update, and the price of the game will be increased!
notes.content:
Fixed the issue with failed settlement after purchasing Experience Scroll.
Fixed the issue of movement speed stacking caused by Flamethrower and Speed Potion.
Adjusted the game difficulty by increasing the required experience for leveling up.
Now, there will be a monster onslaught triggered every 5 and 10 minutes, with a 10% increase in monster spawn rate and strength.
When the main and sub classes are the same, the growth bonus for the sub class is 30%; otherwise, it is 20%.
[b]Due to the current financial constraints that make it difficult to sustain game updates (running out of money for meals), we have made the decision to increase the price of the game to 11 yuan after the initial discount. This adjustment is necessary to ensure that we can continue to release more new content in the future. We kindly ask for your understanding and support.[/b]
